name: Seestar S50
description: ZWO Seestar S50 all-in-one smart telescope
notes: Seeded rig. 250mm focal length and 2.9um pixels give roughly 2.4 arcsec/px over a 1.29 x 0.73 degree field. Internal changer holds UV/IR-cut duo-band and an opaque dark position.

name: Seestar S30
description: ZWO Seestar S30 all-in-one smart telescope
notes: Seeded rig. 150mm focal length and 2.9um pixels give roughly 4.0 arcsec/px over a 2.46 degree diagonal field.

name: Seestar S30 Pro
description: ZWO Seestar S30 Pro all-in-one smart telescope
notes: Seeded rig. 160mm focal length and 2.9um pixels give roughly 3.7 arcsec/px over a 4.6 degree diagonal field. Same aperture as the S30 but four times the sensor area.

name: DWARF mini
description: DwarfLab DWARF mini all-in-one smart telescope
notes: Seeded rig. Roughly 4 arcsec/px over a 2.46 x 1.2 degree field. Writes no IMAGETYP to its FITS headers — ingest classifies its frames from on-sky header evidence and the filename instead.

name: DWARF II
description: DwarfLab DWARF II all-in-one smart telescope
notes: Seeded rig. 1.45um pixels at 100mm give roughly 3.0 arcsec/px. No internal filter changer — DWARF II filters are external 1.25 inch accessories fitted with an adapter.
